result.instructions: Tools for AskNicely, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "What is our NPS for the last 30 days, and how does it compare with the last 90 days?"; "Show the most recent survey responses with a score below 6 and their comments."; "Find the contact jane@example.com and tell me their segment and when we last emailed them.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes AskNicely data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run asknicely_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run asknicely_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run asknicely_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. asknicely_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: asknicely_get_nps
tools.title: Get NPS score
tools.description: Get the Net Promoter Score for the last N days, optionally filtered by custom fields (e.g. country_c = Canada). Returns the score as text. AskNicely API: GET /api/v1/getnps/{days}.

days.description: Days back from today to cover (default 30).

filters.description: Filters on custom fields. Each entry pairs a field name with the value to match.

tools.name: asknicely_get_historical_stats
tools.title: Get email statistics
tools.description: Get statistics of the surveys AskNicely sent, for a day, month or year, optionally by segment or time range. AskNicely API: GET /api/v1/stats.

segment.description: Only count this customer segment, e.g. "VIP Customer".

start_time.description: Unix timestamp: responses sent at or after this time.

end_time.description: Unix timestamp: responses sent at or before this time.

tools.name: asknicely_get_contact
tools.title: Get a contact
tools.description: Get one contact (name, segment, last emailed time, active flag, unsubscribe time) by email, id or a custom field. AskNicely API: GET /api/v1/contact/get/{search}/{key}.

search.description: The value to find, e.g. schrodinger@example.com.

key.description: Field to search by: "email" (default), "id", or a custom field name such as "customer_id_c".

tools.name: asknicely_list_responses
tools.title: List survey responses
tools.description: List survey responses (score, comment, responder, question type) since a unix time, newest or oldest first. Use filter=raw to include surveys not answered yet. Up to 50,000 per call; follow the page numbers for more. AskNicely API: GET /api/v1/responses/{...}.

since_time.description: Unix timestamp: only responses after this time (0 = all).

filter.description: answered (default): responses only; raw: all surveys sent; published: testimonials only.

sort_by.description: Sort by send date or response date (default responded).

end_time.description: Unix timestamp: only responses before this time (default now).

tools.name: asknicely_list_unsubscribed
tools.title: List unsubscribed contacts
tools.description: List every contact who unsubscribed from AskNicely emails. Check this before you send a survey by another route. AskNicely API: GET /api/v1/contacts/unsubscribed.

tools.name: asknicely_add_contacts
tools.title: Add or update contacts
tools.description: Add or update up to 500 contacts in one call (email is required; name, segment and custom fields are optional). By default no survey is sent. Set obeyrules=true to send surveys to eligible contacts. A contact who unsubscribed stays unsubscribed. AskNicely API: POST /api/v1/contacts/add.

contacts.description: Contacts. Extra keys must be custom fields named in snake_case ending in "_c".

obeyrules.description: true: send a survey to eligible contacts under the account's contact rules (default false).

tools.name: asknicely_send_survey
tools.title: Send a survey
tools.description: Send one NPS survey email to a customer, if the account's contact rules allow it. This emails a real customer. Use asknicely_add_contacts with obeyrules=false to add a contact without sending. AskNicely API: POST /api/v1/contact/trigger.

delay_minutes.description: Send the survey after this many minutes (0 = now).

custom_fields.description: Extra custom data, keyed by field name. Names must end in "_c", e.g. {"branch_location_c": "Portland"}.

tools.name: asknicely_remove_contact
tools.title: Deactivate a contact
tools.description: Deactivate a contact so they get no more surveys. The contact is kept, not deleted, and asknicely_add_contacts re-activates them. For a GDPR erasure, use the AskNicely dashboard. AskNicely API: GET /api/v1/contact/remove/{search}/{key}.

search.description: The value to find, e.g. schrodinger@example.com.

key.description: Field to search by: "email" (default), "id", or a custom field name such as "customer_id_c".
